paper_title: Cosmological bounds on pseudo Nambu-Goldstone bosons
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (L = -(g/4) F Fdual phi)
notes: Cadamuro & Redondo (arXiv:1110.2895) present new cosmological exclusion bounds on ALP two-photon coupling g vs mass m_phi (Fig. 1), combining Neff (WMAP7, 99% CL), BBN deuterium/helium, CMB spectral distortions (mu, y), reionization (xion), EBL/X-ray/optical decay photon searches, and DM overclosure (m > 154 eV excluded for stable ALPs). No numerical table is provided; the exclusion is presented as summary plots. Emitted data_points trace an APPROXIMATE lower envelope of the combined excluded region reconstructed from text formulas: Eq. 3.11 (g >~ 1e-3 (eV/m)^{3/2} GeV^-1 low-mass validity boundary), the 154 eV DM overclosure threshold, and the g ~ 1e-17 GeV^-1 floor where freeze-out temperature would exceed the Planck scale. For precise contours the published Fig. 1 should be digitized. Coupling type unambiguous (anomalous two-photon ALP coupling); data quality approximate, hence confidence 0.5. Not a haloscope; no local DM density assumption.
